memberdef.argsstring: (InputIt First, InputIt Last, OutputIt1 d1, OutputIt2 d2, UnaryPredicate Predicate)
memberdef.name: copy_if_else

briefdescription.para: Copy elements in the range [First, Last) to d1 when the predicate is true or d2 when the predicate is false.

detaileddescription.para: This is essentially both std::copy_if and std::remove_copy_if combined into a single pass.

memberdef.argsstring: (InputIt First, InputIt Last, UnaryPredicate Predicate, Comparator BetterThan)
memberdef.name: find_best

briefdescription.para: Find the best match in the range [First, Last).

detaileddescription.para: An element matches when Predicate(X) returns FindBest_Match or FindBest_PerfectMatch. A value of FindBest_PerfectMatch also terminates the search. BetterThan(A, B) is a comparator that returns true when A is a better match than B. The return value is the position of the best match.
This is similar to std::find_if but finds the best of multiple possible matches.

briefdescription.para: Determine the low relocation that matches the given relocation.

detaileddescription.para: If the relocation does not need a low relocation then the return value is ELF::R_MIPS_NONE.
The relocations that need a matching low part are R_(MIPS|MICROMIPS|MIPS16)_HI16 for all symbols and R_(MIPS|MICROMIPS|MIPS16)_GOT16 for local symbols only.
